text:
Based on the provided onboarding document, there are currently no built-in configuration options or settings documented for adjusting the UI/desktop font size independently.

**Workaround / Best Guess:**
If you are using the Web Dashboard interface (started via `hermes dashboard` at `http://127.0.0.1:9119`), you can use your browser's zoom controls (`Ctrl + +` / `Cmd + +` or browser font settings) to increase the display text size specifically for the Hermes interface without affecting other system applications.
